**Download `VanquishDownloader.exe`** and run it. FFmpeg and Deno are built in, nothing else to install.

`VanquishDownloader-portable.zip` is the same app as a folder. It starts faster because nothing has to be unpacked on launch. Extract it and run `VanquishDownloader.exe` inside.

Highlights:
- Fixed downloads always coming out in low quality (360p)
- Downloads up to 4K/8K with audio, merged without re-encoding
- New layout, working pause/resume, playlist support, M4A, 1440p
- Settings are remembered

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/vanquish1905/youtube-video-downloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the exe is not code-signed. Click "More info" then "Run anyway".
